description: Changes a chain like saving in the editor: name, single settings and once, or the whole chain as definition (from get_chain, with your changes). Saved as a new revision; an active chain keeps running the previous one until activate_chain. A new name alone applies at once. Give the revision you read; if the chain changed since, nothing is saved. Secret settings stay as they are. Ask the user first. Needs a key with “Read and change”.

chainId.description: ID of the chain, from list_chains.

definition.description: The whole chain in the chain format; positions may be left out, secret settings stay empty and keep their values.

customNodes.description: Own nodes with formulas, as in the chain format docs.

edges.description: Connections from an output to an input of the same pin type; each input takes one. Growing inputs such as AND are in0, in1 …

from.description: Output pin as node.pin, such as c1.close.

to.description: Input pin as node.pin, such as r1.in.

name.description: Name of the chain; messages show it as {{kette}}.

id.description: Unique in the chain, starts with a letter, no dot, such as c1 or rsi1.

position.description: Place on the board; leave it out and Bellchain arranges the nodes.

settings.description: Settings by name; missing ones take their default (get_node).

type.description: Node type such as "core.rsi", from list_nodes.

pauseAfterAlert.description: Pause the chain after its first alert.

scanner.description: Scanner: the candle "node" runs once per coin, for a list (pairs, such as ["ETH/USDT"]) or the top N by volume (top: {"count": 20, "quote": "USDT"}).

once.description: Pause the chain after its first alert.

revision.description: Revision from get_chain or list_chains that the change builds on.

settings.description: Own values per node and setting, such as {"k1": {"value": 30}} or {"c1": {"pair": "ETH/USDT"}}; node IDs and settings as in get_chain → definition. Not together with definition.

name: update_chain
title: Change a chain
